opportunities.name: AP critical vow
opportunities.objective: Test AP on attacks that are confirmed critical strikes during Transcendence.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive states that critical strikes gain bonus magic damage with AP; Q adds AP magic on-hit and R instantly activates its enhanced state. Fiendhunter supplies a finite post-R critical volley, while Nashor and Deathcap support AP packets and Infinity Edge tests the separate critical component.
opportunities.requiredState: R ready, item volley active and individual attack crit status logged.
opportunities.failure: AP costs lower physical carry damage and the finite volley ends before a takedown.
opportunities.test: Separate physical crit, passive magic and Q/Nashor packets across AP values, with item-forced versus natural crits.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Passive's compact expression does not establish the base quantity its magic coefficient multiplies.

opportunities.name: Unleash spread audit
opportunities.objective: Compare Q's native spread with item-based on-hit distribution.
opportunities.mechanic: Attacks earn one Unleash or two against champions; eight enables five seconds of Q attack speed, extra on-hit and physical spread. Runaan and Statikk provide separate described on-hit propagation. E speed or its R-state dash supports access, while Terminus requires actual attack ramp.
opportunities.requiredState: Eight earned Unleash without R in baseline, several off-axis enemies and recorded energized state.
opportunities.failure: Spread targets stand out of range or AP/attack budget delays essential single-target damage.
opportunities.test: Count Unleash and per-target Q/Statikk/Runaan packets with Q inactive and active, then R-state separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Native Q physical spread does not state that it carries all item or passive on-hits.

ruledOut.reason: Q native spread lists 0.3 AD physical damage; AP improves its distinct magic on-hit rather than that spread term.

unknowns: Passive magic coefficient basis and Q spread inheritance need live testing. R calculations supply empowered W 160/320/480 plus 1.2 AD[statFormula=2] and 0.75 AP despite unresolved tooltip rendering; empty W2/E2 helpers do not establish delivery rules.

builds.name: AP critical vow
builds.summary: Test AP on attacks that are confirmed critical strikes during Transcendence.
builds.goal: Test AP on attacks that are confirmed critical strikes during Transcendence.
builds.hypothesis: Passive states that critical strikes gain bonus magic damage with AP; Q adds AP magic on-hit and R instantly activates its enhanced state. Fiendhunter supplies a finite post-R critical volley, while Nashor and Deathcap support AP packets and Infinity Edge tests the separate critical component.
testPlan: Required state: R ready, item volley active and individual attack crit status logged.
Separate physical crit, passive magic and Q/Nashor packets across AP values, with item-forced versus natural crits.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: AP costs lower physical carry damage and the finite volley ends before a takedown.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Passive's compact expression does not establish the base quantity its magic coefficient multiplies.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Fiendhunter Bolts, Nashor's Tooth, Rabadon's Deathcap, Infinity Edge, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Yunara's Critical Strikes deal an additional [0.1 + (0.001) × AP] magic damage.
Yunara enters a Transcendent State for [15] seconds upgrading her basic Abilities for the duration.
